T: The end of the world. The last of the snacks.
D: A group of actors are trapped in a Hollywood house party when the apocalypse hits.
P: Serve the sweets when they fight over the last chocolate bar.
S: Charred sourdough with tomato, basil, buffalo mozzarella and balsamic

Grilled sourdough rubbed with garlic, piled with marinated cherry tomatoes, basil and torn buffalo mozzarella, finished with balsamic glaze. Quarter 400g cherry tomatoes and toss with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 crushed garlic clove, torn basil and salt, then leave 15 minutes. Slice 1 sourdough loaf into 12 slices, brush with oil and grill or toast until charred. Rub each warm slice with a cut garlic clove. Top with the tomatoes and pieces of 2 buffalo mozzarella balls. Drizzle with balsamic glaze and add a basil leaf.
Rationed pretzels with beer cheese dip
Bite-size soft pretzels with a warm beer cheese dip

Warm soft pretzel bites with a smooth cheddar and beer cheese dip spiked with mustard and paprika. Cut 500g pizza dough into 32 bite-size pieces. Simmer 2L water with 60g bicarb and drop in the pieces for 20 seconds. Drain, lay on a lined tray, brush with egg, sprinkle with sea salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. For the dip, melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, then whisk in 150ml lager and 100ml milk. Add 200g grated cheddar, 1 tsp mustard and a pinch of paprika and stir until smooth.
M: Eggs, bacon, sausages, hash browns, mushrooms and tomato with toast

A full apocalypse fry-up: crispy bacon, sausages, fried eggs, hash browns, garlic mushrooms and grilled tomatoes with buttered toast. Bake 8 frozen hash browns at 220C for 20 minutes. Fry 8 pork sausages over medium heat for 12 minutes. Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Halve 4 tomatoes, season and fry cut-side down for 3 minutes. Fry 250g sliced mushrooms in 30g butter with 1 crushed garlic clove for 5 minutes. Fry 8 eggs in the bacon fat. Toast 8 slices of bread and butter well. Load up 4 plates and serve with tomato sauce.
Pepperoni, mozzarella and hot honey, before the sinkhole opens
Stretched dough topped with tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked very hot and finished with chilli honey and basil.
W: The last chocolate caramel nougat bar
Marshmallow nougat, soft caramel and milk chocolate, cut into bars

Homemade bars of fluffy malted nougat and soft caramel, coated in milk chocolate, so there are enough for everyone. Melt 200g marshmallows with 40g butter, stir in 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tsp vanilla, and press into a lined 20cm square tin. Melt 200g soft caramels with 2 tbsp cream until smooth and spread over the nougat. Chill 30 minutes. Melt 250g milk chocolate with 1 tsp oil and pour over the top. Chill 1 hour until set, then cut into 12 bars with a hot knife.
K: Blended watermelon, lime and mint served cold

Fresh watermelon blitzed with lime and mint, strained and topped with ice-cold water so every drop goes a long way. Cut 1.5kg seedless watermelon into chunks and blend with the juice of 3 limes, a small handful of mint leaves and 2 tbsp caster sugar until smooth. Strain through a sieve into a big jug, pressing on the pulp. Stir in 500ml cold water and chill for 30 minutes. Pour over ice into 4 glasses and garnish with lime wheels and mint sprigs.

note.text: We have supplies for exactly one week. Mostly snacks, and zero plans.

steps.text: Warm the honey with the chilli flakes and leave to infuse.

Stretch each dough thin on baking paper, spread with sauce and top with mozzarella and pepperoni.
Slide onto the hot tray and bake until blistered.
Drizzle with the hot honey and tear over basil.
